          format: int32
          minimum: 0

          readOnly: true

          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.

          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The postal code of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be exactly four
            digits and, when the city maps to a known region (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
            Brisbane->QLD), fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any four-digit postcode. Stored and
            returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it may be supplied in national
            or international form (spaces, dashes and brackets are ignored); it is stored and returned
            in E.164 form (a leading '+' and country code, defaulting to '+61' when none is given).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Create-time flag only. When true, allows creating this owner even though
            another owner has the same last name and address (same household); otherwise such a
            request is rejected with 409 Conflict. Not persisted and not returned.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the
                region code derived from the postcode (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099, else
                UNKNOWN) and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the
                normalized (E.164) telephone concatenated with the last name. Assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-A1B2C3D4'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                <customerCode> is the owner's region-and-hash customer code and YY is the last two digits
                of the registrationDate year. Assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-A1B2C3D4-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by all owners in the same household (same last
                name and address). Assigned at creation; owners who join an existing household via
                'sharesHousehold' receive the same value.
              type: string
              example: 'H-3f2a1c9b8e7d'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created,
                already shared the same first name and last name (compared case-insensitively).
                Assigned at creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the
                customerCode (non-digit characters ignored). Derived per response.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 3 fixed at creation. Starts
                at 1; add 1 when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; capped at 3. Level 4
                is reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's locality, the REGION segment of the customerCode (the region code
                derived from the postcode at creation - NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the postcode resolves to no known region or no customer code is assigned.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created for this owner's
                registration day, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, 'EMAIL' when an email is present,
                otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's derived identity key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId>', used as the single basis for
                duplicate detection. Two owners are duplicates exactly when their whole identity keys
                are equal.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||H-3f2a1c9b8e7d'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The postal code of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be exactly four
            digits and, when the city maps to a known region (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
            Brisbane->QLD), fall within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any four-digit postcode. Stored and
            returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it may be supplied in national
            or international form (spaces, dashes and brackets are ignored); it is stored and returned
            in E.164 form (a leading '+' and country code, defaulting to '+61' when none is given).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it drives the derived ageBand (computed against the registrationDate).
            Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Create-time flag only. When true, allows creating this owner even though
            another owner has the same last name and address (same household); otherwise such a
            request is rejected with 409 Conflict. Not persisted and not returned.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the
                region code derived from the postcode (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099, else
                UNKNOWN) and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the
                normalized (E.164) telephone concatenated with the last name. Assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-A1B2C3D4'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                <customerCode> is the owner's region-and-hash customer code and YY is the last two digits
                of the registrationDate year. Assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-A1B2C3D4-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by all owners in the same household (same last
                name and address). Assigned at creation; owners who join an existing household via
                'sharesHousehold' receive the same value.
              type: string
              example: 'H-3f2a1c9b8e7d'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created,
                already shared the same first name and last name (compared case-insensitively).
                Assigned at creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the
                customerCode (non-digit characters ignored). Derived per response.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 3 fixed at creation. Starts
                at 1; add 1 when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; capped at 3. Level 4
                is reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's locality, the REGION segment of the customerCode (the region code
                derived from the postcode at creation - NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the postcode resolves to no known region or no customer code is assigned.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created for this owner's
                registration day, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, 'EMAIL' when an email is present,
                otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's derived identity key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId>', used as the single basis for
                duplicate detection. Two owners are duplicates exactly when their whole identity keys
                are equal.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||H-3f2a1c9b8e7d'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
